overall.envelope_derivation: Housing rear edge is signal copper inside edge 0.4 minus drawing reference 0.25 = 0.15. Housing front edge is mount copper outside edge 2.9 plus drawing reference 0.15 = 3.05. Closed actuator extends rearward by overall depth 3.5 minus housing depth 2.9 = 0.6. F.Fab is a conservative full-width overall envelope, not a detailed molded outline.
overall.courtyard_note: 0.5 nominal clearance from overall closed envelope; cable routing and open-actuator handling clearance are additional system constraints

signal_pads.numbering: 1..40 from left to right in top view

mounting_pads.electrical_policy: mechanical retention only; do not assign a signal net
mounting_pads.derivation: width=(F-E)/2=0.4; abs(x)=(F+E)/4=10.75. Copper top of signal to bottom of mount is 3.30, so center separation=3.30-0.80/2-0.80/2=2.50.

paste.signal_aperture_placement: centered on copper; separate unnumbered F.Paste-only pads
paste.signal_aperture_evidence: vendor explicitly dimensions 0.25+/-0.03 by 0.65+/-0.03 metal mask
paste.mount_aperture_policy: full copper aperture, a standard assembly choice rather than a claim of exact vendor stencil reproduction; vendor mounting-mask inset diagram is not fully dimensioned
paste.solder_mask: zero per-pad expansion; board/fabricator must retain 0.2 copper-to-copper interpad spacing
